newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ghana Gold says boosts resources.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ghana Gold says boosts resources.

text.p: Australian-headquartered gold miner Ghana Gold Mines Ltd said on Wednesday it had increased the gold resource in its Konongo concession in Ghana by 43 percent to 860,000 ounces in the quarter to December 31.

Chairman Neville Wran said further drilling should lift resources to the the one million ounce mark in the current quarter. Ghana Gold said it produced 3,732 ounces of gold during the quarter at an average cash cost of US$413 an ounce, and was reviewing the viability of production at current gold prices.
